dataset.citation: Hendrycks, Burns, Chen and Ball (2021). CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review. https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.06268
limitations: Positive gold spans only; not full-contract extraction or business-risk severity.
Custom grouped splits are not the official CUAD benchmark.
Issuer grouping is filename-derived and lexical clustering cannot prove absence of all leakage.

selection_rule: Highest validation macro F1; fixed configurations; ties retain model order.

shap_example.label: Cap On Liability
shap_example.note: Top present TF-IDF features only; omitted/absent features can also contribute. Explains the original model output, not calibrated probability, legal correctness or risk.

limitations: Clause type is not legal risk. No validated low/medium/high risk model.
Positive gold spans only; full uploaded clauses and unseen categories are out of distribution.
The 0.65 review threshold is an operational heuristic, not a legal confidence guarantee.
Temperature scaling and a small held-out test do not establish production calibration.
